<?php
@mkdir('/output', 0777, true);
register_shutdown_function(function () {
  $e = error_get_last();
  if ($e && in_array($e['type'], array(E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR), true)) {
    file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', "FATAL\n" . print_r($e, true));
  }
});
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$errors = array();
$ok = array();
try {
  if (function_exists('maison_calista_run_setup_safe')) {
    maison_calista_run_setup_safe(true);
  }
  if (function_exists('maison_calista_demo_is_complete') && maison_calista_demo_is_complete()) {
    $ok[] = 'Demo complete';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Demo incomplete';
  }
  $h = function_exists('maison_calista_theme_header') ? maison_calista_theme_header() : '';
  if (strpos($h, 'mc-header') !== false && strpos($h, 'wp-block-navigation__container') !== false && strpos($h, 'mc-btn-cta') !== false) {
    $ok[] = 'Header chrome OK';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Header chrome bad len=' . strlen($h);
  }
  $f = function_exists('maison_calista_theme_footer') ? maison_calista_theme_footer() : '';
  if (strpos($f, 'mc-footer__grid') !== false) {
    $ok[] = 'Footer chrome OK';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Footer chrome bad';
  }
  $home = get_page_by_path('home');
  if ($home && strpos((string) $home->post_content, 'mc-hero') !== false && strpos((string) $home->post_content, 'mc-usp-grid') !== false) {
    $ok[] = 'Home content has hero + USP';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Home content incomplete';
  }
  $raw = (string) @file_get_contents(get_template_directory() . '/templates/front-page.html');
  if (strpos($raw, 'mc-main') !== false && strpos($raw, '"type":"default"') !== false) {
    $ok[] = 'front-page full-width';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'front-page template wrong';
  }
  $parts = (string) @file_get_contents(get_template_directory() . '/parts/header.html');
  if (strpos($parts, 'mc_theme_header') !== false) {
    $ok[] = 'Header part uses mc_theme_header';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Header part wrong';
  }
  $tj = json_decode((string) file_get_contents(get_template_directory() . '/theme.json'), true);
  if (($tj['settings']['layout']['contentSize'] ?? '') === '1200px' && ($tj['styles']['spacing']['padding']['left'] ?? '') === '0') {
    $ok[] = 'theme.json layout OK';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'theme.json layout bad';
  }
  $css = (string) file_get_contents(get_template_directory() . '/assets/css/main.css');
  if (strpos($css, 'WordPress FSE / preview parity') !== false) {
    $ok[] = 'Parity CSS present';
  } else {
    $errors[] = 'Parity CSS missing';
  }
  $ok[] = 'Patterns ' . count(glob(get_template_directory() . '/patterns/*.php') ?: array());
  $ok[] = 'v' . wp_get_theme()->get('Version');
  $ok[] = 'WP ' . get_bloginfo('version');
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $errors[] = 'EX: ' . $e->getMessage() . ' @ ' . $e->getFile() . ':' . $e->getLine();
}
$report = array('=== 1.3.4 preview parity ===');
foreach ($ok as $l) { $report[] = 'PASS: ' . $l; }
foreach ($errors as $l) { $report[] = 'ERROR: ' . $l; }
$report[] = 'RESULT=' . ($errors ? 'FAIL' : 'PASS');
$text = implode("\n", $report) . "\n";
file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', $text);
echo $text;
